drivers: Three independent attributes (count, fill, rotation) must each be solved; distractors differ on exactly one attribute so any slip yields a wrong option
Count progression (4,3,2) and fill distribution-of-three are easy to spot
Rotation rule is a row-wise 45° decrement that does not hold down columns, and the third row starts at a different angle, making 'upright' less obvious
105 s is adequate for systematic elimination; shape dimension is given away since all options are triangles
